acquisition_method.evidence: Each fraction was injected into a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) for LC-MS/MS analysis.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Reduced cysteine residues were blocked with 100 μl iodoacetamide (0.05 M in UA buffer) and the samples were incubated for 20 min in the dark.
